layerItems.description:
OpenEmbedded-Core is a layer containing the core metadata for current versions
of OpenEmbedded. It is distro-less (can build a functional image with
DISTRO = "nodistro") and contains only emulated machine support.
layerItems.name: openembedded-core

layerItems.description:
meta-clang only maintains a single version of CLANG, which is always the latest version matching the LLVM version in openembedded-core.

The problem with only keeping a single LLVM or CLANG version is that crucial projects are slow to update their LLVM version support. This layer allows building such projects.
layerItems.name: meta-clang-revival
layerItems.summary: This Yocto layer contains older CLANG versions revived from meta-clang.
